

 # LLD for Windows lib dependencies
 
 lld-link.exe has zero dependencies (excluding the kernel32)

 lld-link.exe needs to link in the target executable the following libs:

 crt2.o
 libadvapi32.a
 libgcc.a
 libgcc_eh.a
 libkernel32.a
 libmingw32.a
 libmingwex.a
 libmoldname.a
 libshell32.a
 libucrt.a
 libuser32.a

 # LLD for Linux dependencies

 ld.lld has the following dependencies:

 linux-vdso.so.1 
 libpthread.so.0 
 libdl.so.2 
 libm.so.6 
 libc.so.6 
 /lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2 

 ld.lld needs to link in the target executable the following libs:
 
 crt1.o
 libc.a
